integrity: Proof and checker are provided; direct exhaustive verification is for m=3,4,5 only. General theorem is proven symbolically. No independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to binary RM(2,m), m>=3, evaluated in least-significant-bit-first numerical order, under cyclic pair weight. Arbitrary coordinate orders and higher-degree/nonbinary codes are not covered. Historical priority remains subject to independent checking.
title: The dyadic symbol-pair generation filtration of binary second-order Reed–Muller codes
